Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer:
Two-factor authentication (2FA) is a specific type of multi-factor authentication that adds an extra layer of security to an account. To enable 2FA, you typically go to the security settings of your account and click "Enable". Two-factor authentication requires two or more credentials for verification, such as a password and a verification code sent to your phone or generated by an authenticator app. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login. This helps protect your account from unauthorized access even if your password is compromised.
